title: Getting started
text: Converts panel long wide format. Y N x T outcome dataframe. W N x T dataframe stair-like structure due staggered adoption. X dataframe auxiliary data like weights covariates.

title: Getting started
text: level cohort, aggregates data cohort level. level unit, removes adoption date column. Y W dataframes converted matrices, X dataframe remains . Estimate s^2 - noise variance. s2 utilized determining regularization parameter: η2=s2/n0.9\eta^2 = s^2/n^{0.9}. get upper bound s^2, time unit fixed effects estimated untreated observations. s^2 computed residual sum squares divided degrees freedom. weights passed, WLS estimated rather OLS. can change default cohort weights (sum weights units cohort). weight estimated effects provided weights, need set aggregate_by_weight function aggregate_effect parameter. Estimate treatment effect. can specify function aggregate_effect penalty_func functions. - first function specifies aggregation estimated effects conducted. take following parameters: tau, var, W, coh_weights, N0, N. second function computes regularization parameter η\eta. prior domain knowledge parameter, can create function . function s2 N arguments. Conduct Bayesian bootstrap obtain standard errors estimator.
code:
panel <- to_wide(CHC,   unit = 1, time = 3, outcome = 2,   treatment = 4, contr_covs = c(5), treat_covs = c(),   weight = 6 )  panel$X$popwt <- panel$X$popwt / 10000  panel_avg <- prepare_wide(panel, level = "cohort") s2 <- estimate_s2(panel$Y[, -1], panel$W[, -1], panel$X$popwt) panel_avg$coh_weights ##  [1] 1504.1080  766.4536 2326.6195 2192.5936  726.5843 1060.1646  166.9377 ##  [8] 2041.4321  240.5665  296.1709   43.9506  347.0123   75.3100  641.3449 ## [15]  333.2621  592.1347  313.2747  477.2299 1627.6912  128.5216 est <- sequential_estimator(   panel_avg,   s2 = s2,   type = "both",   aggregate_effect = aggregate_inv_did_var,   penalty_func = default_penalty ) print(est, n_lags = 11) ## Synthetic DiD: ## -4.76 -5.68 -6.57 -9.45 -13.25 -13.57 -16.13 -11.44 -13.09 -12.84 -11.88  ##  ## DiD: ## -6.30 -7.88 -7.41 -9.41 -10.61 -11.58 -10.59 -10.30 -9.62 -10.06 -7.15  ##  ## s2: 2728.60 se <- vcov(est, panel, B = 1000) cat("St. error of SDiD estimator:", "
") ## St. error of SDiD estimator: cat(sprintf("%1.2f", se$se_sdid[1:11]), "

") ## 3.46 3.53 4.44 4.47 5.26 5.31 6.00 6.32 6.60 7.38 7.00 cat("St. error of DiD estimator:", "
") ## St. error of DiD estimator: cat(sprintf("%1.2f", se$se_did[1:11]), "
") ## 2.37 2.60 2.71 2.62 2.83 2.77 3.15 3.02 3.18 3.61 3.63 plot(   est, se, 11,   error_bar_width = 0.4, xlab = "Lags",   legend_position = "right" )
